legacy_reference.scope: Exact pre-optimization projection and adaptive fit; only two explicit preload path adaptations create independent original prepare chain

method.identity: Every complete return and input state byte checked. No rounding, ignored fields or normalized comparison.
method.order: Untimed baseline result seed, then two OFF warmups per version. Ten measured alternating OFF pairs; waterway uses all six orders of three versions four times (24 triplets). All raw observations retained.
method.profiles: Current obstacle_shapes includes lazy road XZ bounds for distant-terrain rejection. Collision retains original exact road footprint construction; only rectangles cached per prepare. Counts report actual expansion, not all source cells.
method.reference: 12e3c91 road_tools, unchanged shared helpers; waterway additionally compares the independently frozen pre-optimization full chain.
method.scope: CPU fixture preparation only; no significance, P95/P99, editor frame, HTTP latency, whole-town or memory claim. Other sessions/system load remain unmanaged.
method.timing: Wall around prepare only. Setup, serialization, checks, hashes and evidence I/O excluded. One final ON diagnostic per version, excluded from OFF statistics.
